samples.title: Afterglow Avenue
samples.lyrics:
Neon signs blur in the rain
Streetlights hum a soft refrain
The city sleeps, but I am awake
Chasing echoes for your sake
Warm analog waves crash low
Pulsing bass begins to glow
We drive through shadows, side by side
Nowhere left for us to hide
The night is young, the road is clear
Whispering all that we hold dear
Home awaits at the end of light
samples.style: Synth-pop: warm analog synths, pulsing bass, crisp drums, melodic sung lead, clear final cadence
samples.mood: Hopeful and warmly nostalgic; a late-night journey home
